questions.q: In English sentence stress, which categories of words are typically stressed?
questions.explain: In spoken English, content words (nouns, main verbs, adjectives, adverbs) carry the meaning and are naturally stressed, whereas function words are typically unstressed.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: In the sentence, 'I MUST GO to the STORE,' which words are the stressed content words?
questions.explain: Generally, content words (verbs like 'go', nouns like 'store') carry the stress. Modals (must) and pronouns/prepositions (I, to, the) are usually unstressed in natural speech, though 'must' can be stressed for emphasis. 'GO' and 'STORE' are the primary stressed content words.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: In standard English sentence stress, words like 'a', 'the', 'and', or 'of' are considered:
options: Content words and are heavily stressed
Function words and are heavily stressed
Content words and are normally unstressed
Function words and are normally unstressed
questions.explain: Articles, conjunctions, and prepositions are function words. In the natural rhythm of English speech, they are normally unstressed.
